Title: General availability: Azure Cache for Redis active geo-replication in enterprise tiers

Body.Content:
Active geo-replication gives you the ability to link up to five Azure Cache for Redis clusters across regions. This feature allows a multi-primary configuration, where writes to one region are reflected automatically in all other linked regions with consistency. Active geo-replication enables new use-cases for developers and provides higher availability—up to 99.999 percent. Configure an active geo-replicated Azure Cache today in the Azure portal.

Learn more.
